status.current: rescued and taken toward Japan by Ouma's group
status.condition: traumatized and physically exhausted after fantasy-form fire torture

relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Father; urges him not to yield because the Kazamatsuri family exists to preserve a false but precious peace.
relationships.sara-bloodlily: Adopted sister/retainer figure tortured alongside her; Rinna orders Sara to endure with her.
relationships.charlotte-corday: Maid whose hidden escape brings Ouma to the rescue.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Rescuer who follows Charlotte's plea to the Tatra base.

periods.summary: Rinna accompanies her father to the ruined Rebellion base and explains that she knows the true history of the Second World War and the Tyrant. Abraham's mind control forces her into the base, then PSYON captures her. At the Tatra base she and Sara are stripped and bound so Arlanz can use them as leverage. Rinna bravely tells her father she will not scream because she is a Kazamatsuri, but the fantasy-form fire torture overwhelms her body. Her suffering breaks Kazamatsuri's resistance, and she is later found unconscious by Ouma during the rescue.

key_events.summary: Witnesses the dead Tyrant and is abducted by PSYON.
Is tortured to pressure Kazamatsuri and Tsukikage.
Escapes the base with Ouma and the other captives.

abilities: Beast Tamer (not actively used while restrained in this volume)
